apsimR's external-authority (APSIM) fact registry

Source: R/external_facts.R
apsim_external_facts.Rd

Enumerates the class-8 facts apsimR asserts about the APSIM simulator – the DataStore SQLite schema, the "Current" checkpoint, report column names, and manager node paths – with the oracle that grounds each and the date it was last diffed against a live APSIM install. A fact is grounded only when verified_on is a non-NA date; the DataStore-schema and report-column facts are grounded by the replayed-real-run oracle test, not by a skipped test.

Usage

apsim_external_facts()

Value

A data.frame with fact_family, asserted_value, oracle_kind, verified_on (Date/NA), evidence_path, and a derived grounding token ("grounded" / "ungrounded").

Examples

apsim_external_facts()
#>         fact_family                                asserted_value
#> 1   datastore_table                                  _Simulations
#> 2   datastore_table                                  _Checkpoints
#> 3   datastore_table                                        Report
#> 4  datastore_column                               _Simulations.ID
#> 5  datastore_column                             _Simulations.Name
#> 6  datastore_column                             _Checkpoints.Name
#> 7  datastore_column                           Report.SimulationID
#> 8  datastore_column                           Report.CheckpointID
#> 9   checkpoint_name                                       Current
#> 10    report_column                                         Yield
#> 11    report_column                          Wheat.AboveGround.Wt
#> 12     manager_node           [Fertilise at sowing].Script.Amount
#> 13     manager_node [Sow using a variable rule].Script.Population
#> 14    apsim_version                                 2026.5.8046.0
